build_targets_one_hot_collator: build a data collator that converts batch labels into one-hot vectors given a number of classes
test_convert_to_one_hot: test the convert_to_one_hot function with positive and negative label lists and a number of classes
review_targets_one_hot_default_collator: review the targets_one_hot_default_collator function that stacks batch data and converts labels to one-hot format
